passages.text: Fairtrade Month is for You We are shoppers, grocers, brands and farmers. We come together in the choices we make so that the people who grow our food get a fairer deal for their work. Together, we’re making equitable the new normal — because fairness should never be optional. This October, Hu joins Fairtrade America to honor and celebrate one of the cocoa farmers who has made an impact within their community. Highlight illustration Photo provided by Fairtrade Africa

Fairtrade standards As a proud partner of Fairtrade, Hu sources 100% of its cocoa, coconut sugar, cashews, vanilla, and quinoa on Fairtrade terms. As a values driven brand, we put Humanity at the forefront of everything we do to help create a positive impact for all of our fellow humans from growers to eaters. What does Fairtrade mean? Being certified Fairtrade means farming organizations are able to earn at least the Fairtrade minimum price, which acts as a safeguard for when market prices drop.

passages.text: The future is fair We saw firsthand how Fairtrade’s approach aims to empower famers and workers in support of more secure livelihoods. As a values-driven brand, we remain committed to sourcing simple and responsible ingredients in partnership with Fairtrade.
Indulgent. Simple. Chocolate. Crafted with care for every moment. ### OUR MISSION We founded Hu to unite simple ingredients with unbeatable taste.

It was an instant hit, inspiring us to bring it to retail stores nationwide. WHERE ARE WE NOW? Today, Hu chocolate is sold in over 34,000 stores across the US, Canada, and the UK. Hu Chocolate uses the same unwavering ingredient guardrails we championed at our Hu Kitchen restaurant. Our organic, Fairtrade dark chocolate is made with just 3 simple and familiar ingredients – cacao, unrefined coconut sugar, and cocoa butter. We avoid things like refined sugar, lecithins, sugar alcohols, and palm oil. Not to be missed are our crave-worthy Salty Dark Chocolate and creamy Nut-Butter-Filled bars – all decadent, indulgent eating experiences that deliver on both taste and ingredient simplicity.
